name: Salesforce
summary: Since September 2025, new Salesforce users can't authorize a connected app their org hasn't installed, so you package the app from a Developer Edition org and each customer's admin installs it.
scenario: An agent that reads and updates Salesforce records for users in customers' Salesforce orgs.

composio.note: Check the Composio managed OAuth directory for the Salesforce toolkit.

portal.accountNeeded: A Salesforce Developer Edition org (connected apps from production orgs aren't compatible with the packaging requirement).

userCapBeforeApproval.detail: No cap; adoption is gated per org by admin installation instead.

businessVerification.detail: Not for packaging; AppExchange listing is separate.

adminApproval.detail: Since Sept 2025 a customer admin must install the app (or grant a bypass permission) before new users can authorize.

appReview.detail: No Salesforce review for distributing a package install link; customer admins are the gate (see admin approval). AppExchange listing is optional and separate.

securityAssessment.detail: Not for distribution by install link (this scenario). An AppExchange listing has its own security review, which was not checked.

time.note: No provider wait for an install link, but each customer's admin must install before users connect.

nextStep: Sign up for a Developer Edition org, create an External Client App (or connected app) there, and plan to distribute it as a package with an install link for customer admins.

prerequisites.text: A Developer Edition org; production-org connected apps need to be recreated.

steps.title: Create a Developer Edition org
steps.detail: Sign up for a free Developer Edition org to own the app.

steps.title: Create an External Client App or connected app
steps.detail: Salesforce is steering developers to External Client Apps. If creating a connected app, you may need to allow creation under External Client App Settings.

steps.title: Configure OAuth settings
steps.detail: Set the callback URL (e.g. Composio's) and OAuth scopes such as api and refresh_token.

steps.title: Package and get an install URL
steps.detail: Package the app (managed package) and share the install link Salesforce emails you.

steps.title: Give customers admin install instructions
steps.detail: Customer admins install the package before users connect. An agent can write this guide.

review.summary: No central review for install links; customer admins are the gate.
review.meanwhile: Existing authorized users are unaffected; admins can grant 'Approve Uninstalled Connected Apps' temporarily as a workaround.

blockers.fix: The app isn't installed in their org. Have the admin install the package, or temporarily grant 'Approve Uninstalled Connected Apps'.

nuances.text: 'Use Any API Client' bypasses connected app restrictions but should be granted sparingly.
The device flow is affected even for existing users.

uncertainties: These facts come from integration vendors summarizing Salesforce's help article 005132365; the Salesforce article itself was not read in this pass.
AppExchange security review requirements and cost were not checked.

sources.title: MoveData: Salesforce connected app usage restrictions

corrections: Expected 'create a connected app and go'. The Sept 2025 usage restrictions mean customer admins must install the app first.
